The '''Night Brokers''' was a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] around [[3626 BBY]]. By the time of the [[All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally]], the swoop gang [[Horizon's Razor]] had become indebted to the Night Brokers.
